__template__: Hand-authored judgment layer (the overseer's piece). The generic generator joins this to the module's section-index JSON to emit the manifest. Getting scope wrong is the expensive error, so this is authored, not inferred. Replace every <angle-bracket> and delete the __*__ notes. See ../SPEC_module-charter-generator.md.
__location_groups__: One entry per location-group key PREFIX in the module's section index (e.g. all keys G1..G19 share prefix 'G'). scope_tag is one of: core (all playthroughs) | branch:<id> (one fork of a pick-one branch) | villain:<id> (a specific main-villain compound) | toolbox (dip-in reference, always available).
__scope_rules__: The module's own pick-one exclusivity rules. Each rule assigns which tagged content is in scope for a given campaign choice. villain_choice and ch1_branch are examples; name them to fit the module.

villain_choice.source: <book page / rule that states the pick-one villain design>

__npcs__: The module's named cast. scope mirrors a scope_tag. audit_footprint is optional (true/false/null) and only matters when validating against a prior run. location_group is optional.
